verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export or account-exit feature in the evidence. Data retrieval is only implied: the AWS CLI offers console-equivalent programmatic control of services, IAM policies are stored as JSON documents, and cost and usage data can be queried via the Cost Explorer API. Community comments describe AWS egress pricing as high, which makes moving data out costly. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account data export, explicit open-format export guarantees per service, a documented account-closure/leave workflow, and independent corroboration of a successful exit.
